nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: On the seawall, Noah checks the light beyond the point.
nodes.translation: 海堤步道上，Noah 看着岬角那边的光。

nodes.speaker: Noah
nodes.text: Five minutes to the point. The sun sets between those rocks.
nodes.translation: 再走五分钟。到了岬角，正好能拍到太阳落在那两块石头中间。

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: Ruth has stopped beside a heron in the shallows.
nodes.translation: Ruth 已经站住了。浅水里有只苍鹭。

nodes.speaker: Ruth
nodes.text: Ten minutes. It hasn't so much as dipped its beak.
nodes.translation: 十分钟了。连嘴都没沾一下水。

nodes.speaker: Noah
nodes.text: You can sit down, you know. That bench has a view too.
nodes.translation: 你可以坐会儿啊。从长椅上也看得见。

nodes.speaker: Ruth
nodes.text: From here I can see what it's looking at. Give it a minute.
nodes.translation: 这儿能看清它盯着哪儿。再等它一分钟。

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: Noah raises his camera. One foot is still turned away.
nodes.translation: Noah 抬起相机，一只脚还朝着岬角那边。

nodes.speaker: 你的选择
nodes.text: Wait by the water or split up for a bit?
nodes.translation: 一起留在水边，还是先分开一会儿？

choices.text: Let's stay. I want to see what it's looking at.
choices.translation: 留这儿吧。我也想看看它在盯什么。

review.context: Noah 想赶到能拍见太阳落在两块石头之间的位置，Ruth 还想盯一会儿苍鹭。
review.outcome: 你们看到苍鹭吞鱼，Noah 拍了十七张都没赶上那一下，也没到岬角。

choices.text: Go on, Noah. Ruth and I will wait on the bench.
choices.translation: Noah，你先去拍吧。我和 Ruth 在长椅等你。

review.context: Noah 想赶到岬角，长椅上也看得见苍鹭。
review.outcome: Ruth 擦眼镜时错过了鸟抓鱼，Noah 带着岬角的照片回来，坐下来给你们看。

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: Noah stays. From here, a rock cuts across the sun.
nodes.translation: Noah 留下了。从这里看过去，一块石头挡住了太阳。

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: The heron strikes. A tiny fish flashes in its beak.
nodes.translation: 苍鹭脑袋突然往下一扎，叼起来好小一条鱼。

nodes.speaker: Ruth
nodes.text: Oh. It just swallowed it. Did you get that?
nodes.translation: 哎，一下就吞了。你拍到了吗？

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: Noah checks his pictures. Not one has the fish in it.
nodes.translation: Noah 翻看照片。没有一张拍到鱼。

nodes.speaker: Noah
nodes.text: Seventeen shots. Every single one of it standing still.
nodes.translation: 十七张。怎么全是它站着不动啊。

nodes.speaker: 你
nodes.text: Go back one. I can see its foot in that one.
nodes.translation: 往回翻一张。那张能看见它的脚。

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: Noah stops scrolling. Ruth looks from the screen to the water.
nodes.translation: Noah 停在那张。Ruth 看完照片，又往水里看了一眼。

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: Noah goes ahead. You and Ruth take the bench.
nodes.translation: Noah 先走了。你和 Ruth 坐到长椅上。

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: Ruth takes off her glasses. A splash, then a fish in its beak.
nodes.translation: Ruth 摘下眼镜要擦。水里“啪”地一声，苍鹭叼起了一条鱼。

nodes.speaker: Ruth
nodes.text: Was that it? I've got a smear right across both lenses.
nodes.translation: 刚才是它？我把两片镜片都擦糊了。

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: Noah comes back. On his screen, the sun fills the gap.
nodes.translation: Noah 回来了。照片上，太阳正好落在两块石头中间。

nodes.speaker: Noah
nodes.text: I got two frames before it slipped behind the rock.
nodes.translation: 太阳被石头挡住前，我就来得及按两下。

nodes.speaker: Ruth
nodes.text: Hold it there. I want to see it with my glasses on.
nodes.translation: 先别收。我把眼镜戴上看看。

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: Noah sits down and holds the screen between you and Ruth.
nodes.translation: Noah 也坐了下来，把相机举在你和 Ruth 中间。
